reviewPolicy.sourcePolicy: Scope to request Segment 151 in InComm OTC Market Basket Data input context. Use the field-2 R marker and its four-character length-indicator definition.
reviewPolicy.dataPolicy: Symbolic field design only. No complete market-basket dataset or computed length is fabricated because the full format is external to the cited ATL105 excerpt.
reviewPolicy.baselinePolicy: References BR-RULE-SEG151-R-005 placeholder; no official Test record is modified.
reviewPolicy.promotionGate: Authorized Test review must supply the applicable InComm market-basket format, complete dataset, computed length, framing, and expected validation before execution or promotion.

sourceEvidence.quote: This section describes Data Segment No. 151, Incomm OTC Market Basket Data (Input) Segment.
sourceEvidence.interpretation: Segment 151 is an Input/request segment; response-side and unrelated financial request cases do not automatically establish applicability.

sourceEvidence.quote: 4 R Indicates the data segment length including the Segment Type length
sourceEvidence.interpretation: Request Segment 151 field 2 / Element 84 is required and has a four-character indicator that includes the Segment Type length.

sourceEvidence.quote: See Buypass Incomm Market Basket Data format document for format details of the Market Basket Data.
sourceEvidence.interpretation: The data field is required but its full serialization details are referred to an external format document not reviewed here, so the total length cannot be independently computed in this draft.

aiReviewReferences.assessment: Four cases name InComm OTC Market Basket Data, but their screened Segment Type observation is 100 with container identity unresolved and Segment 151 Element 84 is only a declared omission. Four other cases do not name the market-basket segment; three have no exact Segment 151 observation, and the Electronic Mail case has two approved payload copies missing.

testScenarios.intent: For an authorized InComm OTC Market Basket request that includes Segment 151, verify required field 2 / Element 84 is present as a four-character indicator. Full length calculation is deferred until the referenced external data format is available.

testCases.assertion: Applicable request Segment 151 includes field 2 / Element 84 with a four-character source-derived length value to be calculated from the reviewed complete request.
Applicable request Segment 151 omits required field 2 / Element 84.
